item.title: Police department eliminated in financial turmoil
item.description: POINT — The City of Point will no longer have a police department beginning Friday after city personnel said they’ve struggled to cover costs while facing a debt of up to $500,000. item.title: Jury duty canceled
item.description: SMITH COUNTY – Jury duty for March 9, 2026 has been canceled. If you received a summons to report to the Smith County Courthouse for jury duty Monday, you do not have to report!
